faq.a: Abdelaziz is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الْعَزِيز, whose core sense is abdelaziz; servant of the mighty.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdelaziz?
faq.a: Abdelaziz is associated with Arabic. Abdelaziz is Arabic عَبْدُ الْعَزِيز (ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz), meaning 'servant of the Mighty'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْعَزِيز is Arabic.
Abdelaziz can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdelaziz should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
